snippet.title: C64 longplay - WEC Le Mans
snippet.description:
Game start 3:44
Game complete 26:29

Nobobdy has ever uploaded a complete longplay of WEC Le Mans for the Commodore 64, so I decided to play the game and do it myself.

This longplay contains the game complete sequence, which ironically is the best (IMO) game complete sequence of any version of WEC Le Mans.

YES I USED UNLIMITED TIME CHEAT.
If anyone is able to complete this game without using a cheat, please upload your video and post the link below, as I would like to see it!
